title: polygram¶
content:
polygram¶

Mobjects that are simple geometric shapes.

Classes

ConvexHull

Constructs a convex hull for a set of points in no particular order.

Cutout

A shape with smaller cutouts.

Polygon

A shape consisting of one closed loop of vertices.

Polygram

A generalizedPolygon, allowing for disconnected sets of edges.

Rectangle

A quadrilateral with two sets of parallel sides.

RegularPolygon

An n-sided regularPolygon.

RegularPolygram

APolygramwith regularly spaced vertices.

RoundedRectangle

A rectangle with rounded corners.

Square

A rectangle with equal side lengths.

Star

A regular polygram without the intersecting lines.

Triangle

An equilateral triangle.
